summary: You take STS 298 and at least 10 units of STS 299 over three quarters, letter graded with a C or better. The honors thesis and the 3.4 GPA (or demonstrated academic competence) are checked by hand.

x351CzSb.why: Requirement 1 says only "a required monthly workshops for current STS honors students" and gives no unit count for STS 298, a 1-unit course. The ten units are STS 299's: "a minimum of ten units total" of STS 299. A 10-unit floor here would mean ten enrollments in the workshop.

b6zWbqq8.why: "Complete a thesis judged worthy of an honors program by the faculty advisor and the STS program."

Sbn7pibb.why: "Have an overall Stanford GPA of 3.4 at the end of winter quarter, senior year, or demonstrated academic competence."

O6qwEwNG.why: Grading: "STS 299 must be taken for a letter grade. Must receive a grade of C or higher."
